info.name: RideApp — Full Backend Collection
info.description:
Complete automated Postman collection for RideApp backend.

Sections:
1. Auth
2. KYC
3. Driver Application
4. Driver
5. Ride Requests & Bidding
6. Rides
7. 💰 Wallet
8. 💳 Payments & Payment Methods
9. 🏦 Payouts (Driver & Admin)
10. 🎁 Promo Codes
11. 🎴 Gift Cards
12. 🔧 Admin — Payment Providers
13. 🔧 Admin — Users
14. 🔧 Admin — Rides & Reviews

Automation:
- Login auto-saves tokens for rider, driver, admin
- IDs auto-extracted and stored as env vars throughout
- Idempotency-Key auto-generated on every mutating request
- All requests pre-configured with correct auth headers
